law: touched-file size law (P11-T0-e): every .py/.sh under build/, tools/, release/ touched between base_commit..HEAD must be <=380 lines — stricter than the whole-tree 400-LOC law; enforced by build/tests/test_file_size_law.py --touched (run_checks p11_size_law + governance) and mirrored in pytest
note: base_commit = the parent of the first P13 commit (the P12 final commit 8db682f). Updated at each phase start; prior bases are kept in history (append-only). P12 did not rotate this file (it still named P11 at P12's close); P13 rotated it as the law requires, so the touched-file law bites on P13's own edits rather than on P11's.
